github.name: create_issue
github.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository. Returns the created issue URL.

github.name: search_code
github.description: Search for code across GitHub repositories using GitHub code search syntax. See https://docs.github.com/en/search-github/searching-on-github/searching-code for query syntax.

github.name: get_file_contents
github.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository.

github.name: create_pull_request
github.description: Create a new pull request. Call get_file_contents first if you need to inspect the base branch.

filesystem.name: read_file
filesystem.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: write_file
filesystem.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: list_directory
filesystem.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results clearly distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

weather.name: get_forecast
weather.description: Get the weather forecast for a location. Provide latitude and longitude in decimal degrees. Data from api.weather.gov.

weather.name: get_alerts
weather.description: Get weather alerts for a US state. You must provide a two-letter state code, e.g. CA.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. CA, NY)

vault.name: rotate_api_key
vault.description: Rotate an API key for a service account. Returns the new key ID (never the secret value).

vault.name: get_commit
vault.description: Fetch a commit by SHA, e.g. 3f786850e387550fdab836ed7e6dc881de23001b.

vault.name: translate
vault.description: Translate text between languages. 将文本翻译成目标语言。Supports emoji 👍🏽 and accented text: café, naïve.

vault.name: add_comment
vault.description: Add a comment to an issue. The notes field is optional free text shown to reviewers.
